title: Go Fast video recorded off Jacksonville
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Go Fast video recorded off Jacksonville, about January 2015 at 300 miles off Jacksonville, Florida, USS Roosevelt, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: 300 miles off Jacksonville, Florida, USS Roosevelt

tellings.quote: let's get into uh the Go Fast video which was recorded in January of 2015, 300 miles off the coast of Jacksonville, the USS Roosevelt.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the Go Fast video, a short Navy cockpit camera clip of an unexplained object, was recorded in January 2015 about 300 miles off the coast of Jacksonville, Florida, by aircraft from the USS Roosevelt, an aircraft carrier. He sets this out as the starting point for discussing the clip, because if the object is what it seems, Navy pilots filmed something they could not identify.
